packageRules.description: CI lanes pin the Node.js version on purpose (floor and latest); do not widen or bump it
.mise.toml pins the local toolchain to the CI latest lane; it is updated by hand together with CI

CI lanes pin the BEAM toolchain on purpose (the floor lane matches gleam.toml and the oldest maintained OTP, release builds the escript on that OTP, the latest lane floats on 1.x); do not bump what erlef/setup-beam installs
